      "name": "ipc",

      "evidence": "Changes the `bitcoin` wrapper executable and process management in `src/bitcoin.cpp`, explicitly covered under IPC.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes Windows process execution for the `bitcoin` wrapper so it properly waits for child processes and returns exit codes. The wrapper was exiting immediately with code 0 on Windows, which broke external callers and forced functional tests like `interface_gui.py` to be skipped."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to `test/functional/test_framework/test_framework.py` and un-skipping tests in `tool_bitcoin.py` merely follow from fixing the wrapper executable.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Follow-up test edits to un-skip tests on Windows do not constitute test framework infrastructure work."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies the behavior of the `bitcoin` wrapper executable (`src/bitcoin.cpp`), explicitly covered under tools.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves a broken execution model for the `bitcoin.exe` CLI wrapper on Windows. Previously, `_execvp` exited the wrapper immediately with status 0 while the child ran asynchronously, preventing callers from waiting on completion or checking return codes."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies `util::ExecVp` in `src/util/exec.cpp` to correctly wait and forward exit codes on Windows, as well as fixing POSIX errno category reporting.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects platform-specific process execution behavior and error category mapping in `util::ExecVp`. While helpful for callers of `ExecVp`, its use is limited to wrapper process invocation."
    }
  ],
